tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The one background. Every screen sits on it flat: no gradients, glows or vignettes anywhere.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: One step up: the search field, banners, sheets, the trade slider track, round action buttons.

tokens.name: raised-2
tokens.usage: Two steps up: secondary buttons, the selected segment, avatar monograms, tooltips, toasts, the tab bar's material.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and above spec-sheet stats, on bg only. Structure comes from these, not from boxes.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The tab bar's edge, the sheet grabber, range-bar tracks, ghost button outlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons; the fill of primary and Buy buttons. 17.6:1 on bg, 14.4:1 on raised-2.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy, the Analyst's notes, button labels under icons. 9.8:1 on bg, 8:1 on raised-2.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Labels, subtitles, timestamps, cents and the A$ sign on big numbers, inactive tabs. 5.8:1 on bg, 4.8:1 on raised-2.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: dotted previous-close lines, chevrons, disabled labels (exempt from contrast rules). 2.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Price up, gains, BEAT, a Buy rating. Only on numbers, chart lines and the slide-to-buy knob, always with an arrow or sign. 10:1 on bg.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Price down, losses, LOSS rulings, liquidation, SEC. Only on numbers, chart lines and glyphs, always with an arrow or sign. 6.8:1 on bg, 5.5:1 on raised-2.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Time and risk: margin warnings, halts, expiring quotes, extended hours. On numbers, countdown digits and banner glyphs. 10.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: on-up
tokens.usage: Glyphs on an up or down fill (the slide knob). 9.9:1 on up.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: primary and Buy button labels. 17.6:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet: dims the screen it came from to two fifths, so the sheet is the only thing lit (W05, W06). Black at 60%.

families.sans: "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: SF Pro Display on iPhone. Big numbers are light, not bold: the size does the work. Tabular figures always.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: net worth, a ruling's landing price, a fine. A$ and cents in ink-tertiary.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The price in a stock header.

styles.name: impact
styles.usage: A ruling's impact score, in up or down.

groups.name: Analyst
groups.note: Apple's New York on iPhone (Newsreader stands in on the web). Only the Analyst speaks in the serif: headlines, notes, Fed statements, company profiles.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Jake indicated sharply lower after overnight “who is this” incident
styles.usage: A headline that is the point of the screen.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Analyst notes, in ink-secondary, never boxed.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: SF Pro Text. Hierarchy comes from size and color, rarely from weight.

styles.name: alert-title
styles.usage: The one statement on a screen that is itself the message (W13). Nothing else on the screen competes with it.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: What happened, on a full-screen outcome (W08). One per screen; a section heading never uses it.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings. Small and confident, never 20pt+.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Runs on the tape next to the story

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Labels, subtitles, metadata, change lines in rows.

groups.name: Tape
groups.note: SF Mono for the ticker tape and countdown digits, so numbers don't jitter as they change.

spacing.note: 4pt base. 16pt side gutter. Sections are separated by space (16–24pt), not by boxes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a number and its change line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Avatar to text; banner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter; gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Before a section heading.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between major groups (hero, then actions, then lists).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Clearance under floating controls.

radius.note: Few radii, smaller than you'd expect. Full capsules only for buttons, the tab bar and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Selected segment, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Search field, banners, toasts, empty-state tile.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, the tab bar, avatars, the slider.

shadow.note: No drop shadows. Floating things use the system material (blur) instead.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px bg gap, then 2px of ink.

tokens.name: size-hit
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target, even for bare glyphs.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatars in rows; 40 in headers.

tokens.name: size-action
tokens.usage: Round action buttons.

tokens.name: size-button-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: List rows.
